EQUATION:
odeType = stiff

; Central compartment
ddt_Ac = -Vm * Ac/V1 / (Km + Ac/V1) - (Q2/V1) * Ac + (Q2/V2) * Ap2 - (Q3/V1) * Ac + (Q3/V3) * Ap3

; Peripheral compartment 1
ddt_Ap2 = (Q2/V1) * Ac - (Q2/V2) * Ap2

; Peripheral compartment 2
ddt_Ap3 = (Q3/V1) * Ac - (Q3/V3) * Ap3

; Concentration in central compartment
Cc = Ac/V1
